\label{Ex_1}
We consider the ECA $74$ and fix $n=4$. In this case, the state space contains $16$ states
and the corresponding directed graph $16$ vertices. The state transition
network, represented in Figure \ref{fig_74}, consists of two components, 
one containing a fixed state and one consisting of a cycle $C_4$ only.

title: Remark
body_md:
Since our classification is based on the spectra of Koopman operators, it is important to 
represent several of them. As shown in Proposition \ref{prop_spectrum}, the spectrum consists only of eigenvalues
on the unit circle of the complex plane, and of the eigenvalue $0$. In the subsequent figures,
we represent the non-zero eigenvalues together with their multiplicity. For that purpose,
observe that any $\lambda \in {\mathbb C}$ with $|\lambda|=1$ can be written uniquely as
$\lambda = \mathrm{e}^{i\theta}$ for some $\theta \in (0,2\pi]$. We call
$\theta$ the argument of $\lambda$, and have chosen the cut at $\theta=0$ in order
to have the eigenvalue $\lambda=1$ represented at $\theta = 2\pi$.
Obviously, the eigenvalue $-1$ is represented at $\theta=\pi$, 
while no eigenvalue is represented at $\theta=0$ since since value is excluded.

On the same pictures we also give an information about the $0$-eigenvalue by
providing the \emph{zero eigenvalue ratio}, namely the ratio of the multiplicity of 
the eigenvalue $0$ divided by the total number of eigenvalues $2^n$, see \eqref{eq_ratio}
and the explanations provided there.
